say:1:1410625001:0.text: Indris, I've heard everything... Are you really going to betray Sal'thorin?
say:1:1410625001:0.source_cn: 因度厄，我已经听说了……你要为了某些虚无缥缈的原因，背...

say:2:1410625002:1.text: I'm simply trying to uncover the truth. Feli's death, the dragon eggs, all of it is real, isn't it?
say:2:1410625002:1.source_cn: 我没有背叛，而且那是真相。斐利尔的死，龙的蛋，这些都是...

say:3:1410625003:0.text: But that's not enough. I have too many questions, and I want to find the full truth.
say:3:1410625003:0.source_cn: 但这些还不够，远远不够，我还想看到更多的真相。

say:4:1410625004:0.text: Where did the dragon eggs come from? Where are the dragons? Why are you hiding them? And why did Feli have to die over this?
say:4:1410625004:0.source_cn: 蛋从哪里来，龙在哪里，为什么你们要隐藏，为什么斐利尔会...

say:5:1410625005:0.text: You're desperate to find a more reasonable explanation for the death of your friend.
say:5:1410625005:0.source_cn: 我明白了，年轻人，你迫切地想要为挚友的去世找到更说得过...

say:6:1410625006:0.text: Otherwise, you wouldn't even know who to blame.
say:6:1410625006:0.source_cn: 如果不这样，你甚至不知道自己该恨谁好。

say:7:1410625007:0.text: Assuming the dragon eggs are really Sal'thorin's secret...
say:7:1410625007:0.source_cn: 假设龙蛋是绝对不可动摇的秘密，关乎萨洛克兰的国土与全部...

say:8:1410625008:0.text: Then Feli must have died for attempting to leak Sal'thorin's secrets to toplanders. Velara must have meant to punish him and simply overestimated her control.
say:8:1410625008:0.source_cn: 那么斐利尔就是由于自己失误泄露了秘密，又因为奎茵一时冲...

say:10:1410625009:0.text: That was no mere mistake! One hit and he was finished—no magic could bring him back!
say:10:1410625009:0.source_cn: 那怎么可能是冲动或失手！一击毙命！连魔法都没法挽救！

say:11:1410625010:0.text: So, this is how the toplanders tricked you. Stirring the flames of confusion, deceiving Feli, and ultimately leading you down this path too.
say:11:1410625010:0.source_cn: 原来如此，因度厄。他们就是这样煽风点火，欺骗了斐利尔，...

say:13:1410625011:1.text: Please, General Thador, I have my own judgment.
say:13:1410625011:1.source_cn: 别太小看我，都铎将军。我亲眼看到了事实。

say:14:1410625012:1.text: The fact that they have you, one of the Three Exarchs, guarding this place speaks volumes.
say:14:1410625012:1.source_cn: 你作为最尊贵的三长老之一，会守卫在这片区域，甚至手执武器……

say:15:1410625013:1.text: Your attempts to stop us only suggest that there's something you're trying to hide.
say:15:1410625013:1.source_cn: 花费唇舌也好，使用武力也罢，你阻拦在此，就证明在那背后...

say:16:1410625014:1.text: Something far darker than the dragon eggs or the mines.
say:16:1410625014:1.source_cn: 比起那蛋壳，蛋清，开采的矮人和矿场更加不可告人的秘密。

say:17:1410625015:0.text: ... I see you cannot be reasoned with.

narration:22:14010639:0.text: To your surprise, the guard ahead turns out to be Thador. He notices your presence at the same time.
narration:22:14010639:0.source_cn: 你们发现在前往把守的人竟然是都铎。与此同时都铎也发现了你们。
narration:22:14010639:0.male: To your surprise, the guard ahead turns out to be Thador. He notices your presence at the same time.
narration:22:14010639:0.female: To your surprise, the guard ahead turns out to be Thador. He notices your presence at the same time.
